title: Pair Friends
scene: Turn over two leaf cards in a small wooden memory grid, revealing a matching pair.

title: Bead Merge
scene: Slide numbered beads on a four-by-four tray, merging equal values into doubled beads.

title: Tangram Friends
lesson: Shapes, area stays the same when pieces move
scene: Fit seven geometric wooden tangram pieces into a friendly animal outline.

title: Jigsaw of Omi
scene: Drag one final jigsaw piece into an illustrated map of Omi.

title: Spot the Change
lesson: Attention; real photos of animals and plants
scene: Compare two botanical pictures side by side and circle one changed leaf.

title: Hidden Links
scene: Find small link-shaped objects among carefully arranged study-room treasures.

title: Slide Home
lesson: Permutations, why half of the positions are unsolvable
scene: Slide numbered wooden tiles into the empty cell of a four-by-four board.

title: Color Cups
scene: Pour a top layer between transparent patterned cups without mixing unlike layers.

title: Shape Garden
scene: Fit flower-shaped polyominoes into an open garden grid to complete a row.

title: Link It!
scene: Draw separate non-crossing paths between matching endpoints on a square grid.

title: Pixel Itsy
scene: Fill cells in a nonogram whose clues reveal an infinity-loop friend.

title: Light the Links
lesson: Parity, linear algebra over two values
scene: Toggle a lamp in a small grid, showing that its orthogonal neighbors change too.

title: Pipe Garden
scene: Rotate pipe elbows to connect a water tank to planted beds in a small grid.

title: Untangle
scene: Drag graph nodes apart until every crossing edge becomes separate.

title: Laser Mirrors
lesson: Optics: angle of incidence equals angle of reflection
scene: Rotate a mirror to reflect one laser beam into a distant flower-shaped receiver.

title: Screw Garden
scene: Unscrew brass fasteners in a clear dependency order to release wooden plates.

title: Push & Think
scene: Push one seed crate toward its marked destination in a small walled warehouse.

title: Gravity Turn
lesson: Gravity as a direction, falling bodies
scene: Rotate a miniature room so gravity rolls a seed into a sheltered planter.

title: Blossom Swap
lesson: Planning cascades and recognizing plant parts
scene: Swap adjacent leaf and flower tiles on a six-by-six garden bed to complete a visible collection goal.

title: Bubble Canopy
scene: Aim a seed bubble at a suspended canopy of matching bubbles, with a dotted wall-bounce preview.

title: Tiny Triples
scene: Find three identical field-study objects in a shallow pile and place them in a seven-slot tray.

title: Pebble Pop
scene: Tap connected same-pattern pebbles in a basin to open a channel for a seed boat.

title: Harvest Drop
scene: Drop round seed pods into a glass planter; matching pods combine into the next larger botanical model.

title: Habitat Merge
scene: Arrange three seed tokens on a hexagonal restoration map to unlock a sapling model, with growth clearly presented as a game abstraction.

title: Bicycle Jam
scene: Slide little cargo bicycles along their marked axes until the library delivery bike can exit.

title: Shuttle Queue
scene: Send color-and-symbol-coded shuttles to a station so waiting link friends can all board safely.

title: Parcel Conveyor
scene: Route patterned parcels from a conveyor into three labeled-by-symbol sorting bays without overflowing a small buffer.

title: One Stroke Garden
scene: Trace every path of a small garden graph exactly once, linking all its flower-shaped junctions.

title: Ribbon Rescue
scene: Move ribbon endpoints between wooden pegs until all colored-and-patterned ribbons lie separately.

title: Trail Numbers
scene: Draw one continuous route through every garden square, visiting numbered checkpoints in order.
